column1: # - Plain names for C symbols and data: Heal
# - C++ signatures are mangled with gcc 2.9x rules (tools/mangle_gcc2.py):
# - Every function you decompile, and every symbol decompiled code references
#   that is not a func_XXXXXXXX / D_XXXXXXXX placeholder, needs a line here.
# --- SCE SDK 2.5.0 (sdk segment). Evidence in the third column; see docs/sdk.md.
#     Generated by tools/sdk_names.py, plus hand entries marked 'hand'.

column3: # hand (newlib): runs the _impure_ptr->_atexit handlers last to first, then __cleanup, then _exit (crt0)
# hand: (size) __malloc_lock; 1832-byte allocator(_impure_ptr, size); __malloc_unlock; returns its result
# hand: (ptr) same lock pair around the 756-byte release routine(_impure_ptr, ptr)
# hand: (a, b, n) quadword compare when aligned, then bytes; returns the byte difference
# hand: (dst, src, n) lq/sq 32-byte loop when aligned, then ld/sd, then bytes; returns dst
# hand: (dst, c, n) pcpyld/pcpyh splat of c, sq/sd loops, then bytes
# hand: recursive lock: GetThreadId owner + count, WaitSema
# hand: drops the count, SignalSema at zero
# hand: (reent, s) strlen; two-entry uio {s, "\n"}; returns '\n' (10) or EOF (-1)
# hand: (reent, buf, fmt, ...) string FILE (flags 0x208, size 0x7FFFFFFF), vfprintf, NUL-terminates
# hand: finds the end of dst (128-bit zero-byte test), strcpy(end, src), returns dst
# hand: (a, b) quadword/doubleword compare with the 0x0101../0x8080.. zero-byte test, then bytes
# hand: (dst, src) quadword/doubleword copy until a zero byte, then bytes; returns dst
# hand: (s) zero-byte search, returns the length
# hand: (a, b, n) like strcmp, bounded by n
# hand: (fp, fmt, ap); printf and sprintf call it
# hand: (buf, fmt, ap) string FILE with _impure_ptr, vfprintf, NUL-terminates
# hand: (reent, buf, fmt, ap) same with an explicit reent
# hand: libkernl printf: installs the DECI2 TTY output routine (0x002593b8) around the format engine; SDK libraries print their errors through it
# hand: called with 0 before every libdbc/libmc/libcdvd bind
# hand: (client, server id 0x800009xx/0x800004xx, mode) in sceDbcInit/sceMcInit
# hand: (client, function no, ...) in every sceDbc* RPC wrapper
# hand (libgcc2): signed 64-bit divide; negates negative operands, no stack frame (no remainder pointer)
# hand: same with a remainder slot on the stack
# hand: unsigned, remainder slot on the stack
# hand: (double) <0 gives 0; hi = __fixunsdfsi(a * 2^-32), then a - __floatdidf(hi << 32) for the low word
# hand: __extendsfdf2 then the same sequence (16 game callers)
# hand (gcc fp-bit): __unpack_f then __make_dp (112 game callers: float to double)
# hand: as __adddf3 with the sign of b flipped
# hand: __unpack_d x2, returns __fpcmp_parts_d directly (game tests the result with bltz/blez/bgez)
# hand: __unpack_d; NaN/zero 0, inf or exp >= 31 saturates to 0x7FFFFFFF/0x80000000
# hand: (class, sign, exp, frac) into a parts struct, __pack_d
# hand: __unpack_d, frac >> 30 with a sticky bit, __make_fp (61 game callers)
# hand: __unpack_d; negative/NaN 0, inf or exp >= 32 gives -1, else shifted fraction
# hand (fp-bit): float bits into class/sign/exp/frac (0x7FFFFF mantissa mask)
# hand: (class, sign, exp, frac) into a parts struct, __pack_f
# hand: parts struct to double bits (0x800FFFFF masks); called by every df routine
# hand: double bits to parts struct; called by every df routine
# hand: compares two parts structs (NaN, inf, zero, sign, exp, frac); only caller __cmpdf2
# hand: parts struct to float bits; only caller __make_fp
# hand: 'libdbc: bind failed', module version check
# hand (libpad2, after libdbc): sets the init flag, clears the 16 socket slots (0x330 bytes each), returns 1
# hand: clears the flag, scePad2DeleteSocket on every open slot
# hand: (param, addr) the only libpad2 caller of sceDbcCreateSocket
# hand: (socket) the only libpad2 caller of sceDbcDeleteSocket

# hand (libpad2): (socket, buf) copies the newer of the slot's two 128-byte DMA buffers (counter at +124) into buf, returns the data length (+2); game reads the digital buttons from buf[0..1] (active low)
# hand: (socket, profile) sceDbcReceiveData into profile, then rebuilds the slot's 40-entry button table from its bitmap; game calls it after GetState == 1 and checks a nibble of the result
# hand: (socket) returns state byte 0 of the latest buffer, or asks the device with sceDbcReceiveData; game loop proceeds only when it returns 1
# hand: (state, str) state < 4 copies a name from a table with strcpy, else ""
# hand (libvib): (socket, profile) sceDbcReceiveData into the caller's buffer
# hand: 5 args (socket, profile_size, profile, data_size, data); memcpy then sceDbcSendData2
# hand (newlib libm, fdlibm): double; |x| thresholds 0x3FDC0000/0x3FF30000/0x40038000/2^66 and the atanhi/atanlo tables
# hand: double; 0x000FFFFF masks, returns 1.0 (0x3FF00000) for small positive x
# hand: |x| <= pi/4 (0x3FE921FB) __kernel_cos(x,0); else __ieee754_rem_pio2 and n&3 picks +-__kernel_cos/__kernel_sin
# hand: returns 0x7FF80000_00000000; game converts it with __truncdfsf2
# hand: as cos with the quadrants rotated; |x| <= pi/4 __kernel_sin(x,0,0)
# hand (wrapper): tail jump to __ieee754_atan2f (58 game callers)
# hand: target of asin's tail jump; 0x3FEF3333 threshold, calls __ieee754_sqrt (split from sqrtf by the session 4 layout fix)
# hand: calls atan and fabs; pi/pi_o_2 table
# hand: (x, y[2]) returns n; pi/2 constants 0x3FF921FB, 0x4002D97B; falls back to __kernel_rem_pio2
# hand: bit-by-bit double square root (inf/NaN: x*x+x); called by __ieee754_asin
# hand: calls atanf and fabsf; +-pi, +-pi/2 constants
# hand: integer-only remainder; (x*y)/(x*y) when y is zero/denormal or x not finite
# hand: 2016 bytes, log/exp polynomial constants, scalbnf, fabsf, tail sqrtf for y == 0.5
# hand: bit-by-bit float square root ((x-x)/(x-x) for negative x)
# hand: Payne-Hanek reduction with the 2/pi table; calls floor and scalbn
# hand: double; returns -1.0 (0xBFF00000) for small negative x
# hand: (double, int); +-50000 limits, huge/tiny with copysign
# hand: float floor with 1e30 (huge) inexact test
# hand (libpc): (control, counter0, counter1) mtps/mtpc under an eret into kernel mode
# hand: clears the CTE bit (31) of the PCCR with mfps/mtps
# hand: 'bind error libmc', mcserv/mcman version checks
# hand (libipu): mode 0 waits for IPU_CTRL.BUSY (bit 31) to clear, mode 1 returns it
# hand: IPU reset (CTRL=0x40000000), BCLR, then SETIQ x2, SETVQ, SETTH with default tables
